name: hive_add_item
description: Add a new item to a Hive kanban board. Status defaults to 'To Do'.

owner.description: Owner name (must match an existing owner)

parent_id.description: ID of parent item (for creating sub-tasks)

position.description: Position in column: 'top', 'bottom', or a 1-based index (default: bottom)

name: hive_create_label
description: Create a new label for Hive board items

board.description: Board name to scope this label to (optional)

name: hive_get_item
description: Get full details of a single Hive item by ID. Use this to read the current description, status, etc. before updating.

item_id.description: ID of the item to fetch

name: hive_list_items
description: List items on a Hive kanban board, optionally filtered by status and/or date range. Omit board to query across all boards.

board.description: Board name (e.g., 'Work', 'Family'). Omit to query all boards.

due_after.description: Only items with due_date >= this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

due_before.description: Only items with due_date <= this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

name: hive_list_labels
description: List valid labels for Hive board items. Optionally filter by board.

board.description: Board name to filter labels by (optional — omit to list all)

name: hive_list_owners
description: List valid owners for Hive board items

name: hive_undo
description: Undo one write an agent made through this connector, using Hive's own Audit Log. With no arguments it lists the last 20 MCP calls, newest first, each with its call id, time, actions and row count. With a call_id it is a dry run: it shows every change it would revert, and writes nothing. With confirm: true it reverts them. If any field the call touched has changed since, nothing is reverted and the changed fields are listed: it is all or nothing. A deleted item comes back with its original id and its sub-tasks, a created item or label is removed. The undo is itself a call in the list, so it can be undone the same way. Only writes made through this connector are in the list: not edits in the app. Reverting can destroy work done since, so only confirm what the user asked to undo.

call_id.description: The call to undo, from the list. Omit to list recent calls

confirm.description: Set true to actually revert. Default false = preview only.

name: hive_update_item
description: Update an existing item on a Hive kanban board. Only provide fields you want to change.

item_id.description: ID of the item to update

due_date.description: New due date in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD)

position.description: Position in column: 'top', 'bottom', or a 1-based index

completed_at.description: When the item is in a terminal column: set when it was completed, as a date (YYYY-MM-DD, stored as noon UTC) or a full ISO 8601 timestamp with Z or an offset, not more than 24 hours ahead. Refused for an item in any other column. Cleared by moving the item out of its terminal column, not by an empty value
